value: Akama seeks the Time-Phased Phylactery once held by Rage Winterchill. The path sends the adventurer into the Caverns of Time and a memory of the Battle of Mount Hyjal, where the artifact is recovered. This is not present-day travel from Outland into the Third War. A separate raid attunement is required to enter Hyjal; that gate is a game condition, not the cause of Akama’s plan.
